info.description: A portfolio project. Powers the work index, the home page list, and the full case study page.

category.description: Sector, e.g. Education or Logistics. Doubles as the filter chip on the Work page.

discipline.description: The kind of work, e.g. Web app design. Shown as the row tag and the case study's Discipline field.

summary.description: One line about the project, used on every card and list row.

order.description: Lowest first. Controls the numbering (01, 02, ...) and the Next project link.

featured.description: The featured project gets the large 16:9 treatment at the top of the home page list.

chipBg.description: Placeholder tile colour shown behind or instead of the cover image.

chipInk.description: Colour of the initials shown when there is no cover image.

briefLead.description: The large opening line of "The brief".

briefBody.description: The supporting paragraph under the brief.

problemLead.description: The large opening line of "The problem".

constraints.description: The numbered constraints. The design shows three.

decisions.description: The decision cards under the approach. The design shows three across.

shippedHeading.default: The screens that carry the work.

gallery.description: The "What shipped" grid. The design lays out two side by side.
